The following events took place in '''42 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] formed the [[Malarian Alliance]] and signed the [[Keitumite Mutual Military Treaty]].<ref name="The Approaching Storm">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
*[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] work in tandem to perform the [[Grand Experiment]], attempting to create life via [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and unintentionally conceive [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] instead.
*[[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] constructs the [[Mandator-class Star Dreadnaught|''Mandator''-class Star Dreadnaught]], the first [[Warship/Legends|warship]] to be designated as a Dreadnaught by the [[Republic Navy War College/Legends|Anaxes War College]].<ref name="EGW" />
